issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): usage presentation split imports private helpers across new modules
issue.description:
`just _lint-symvision` (and so `just check`, which stops before the test lane) fails on
master `37bf26429` with "Private functions/classes should not be imported" for helpers
that `d7faebddf` ("refactor(usage): split presentation.py into facade plus four modules",
toobig routine agent `toobig-5y.presentation.0`) now imports across the new modules:

- `src/sase/llm_provider/usage/presentation.py` imports privates from
  `_presentation_labels` (`_collector_health_label`, `_collector_health_style`, ...),
  `_presentation_render`, and `_presentation_snapshot`.
- `_presentation_labels.py`, `_presentation_render.py`, `_presentation_snapshot.py`
  cross-import privates from `_presentation_shared.py` (`_provider_rows`,
  `_window_rows`, `_optional_text`, `_string_list`, `_provider_collector_health`,
  `_remaining_label`, `_window_source_label`, `_window_status_label_for_provider`,
  `_usage_diagnostic_to_json`, `_format_number`, `_number`, ...). Because symvision
  matches by name, names like `_optional_text` / `_string_list` also list every other
  same-named private def in the repo; those are noise from this split, not separate
  defects.

Root cause: the split kept `_`-prefixed names while moving them into separate modules.
Fix: make the cross-module helpers public in the new private modules (the modules are
already `_`-prefixed, so public names inside them stay package-internal), or fold
helpers back so each is used only in its defining file. Same pattern as sase-13l,
sase-10n, sase-zk. The plugins_browser half of the same symvision output is sase-17c.

Discovered by sase-17a.land while landing epic sase-17a (proposal originated in
sase-17a.2's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note, which named only the plugins_browser half).
